notes.title: Minor Update - Laser Focus Bug, other minor changes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug on the 'Laser Focus' level; the level would not finish.
- Minor updates to car models and colors.
- Minor audio changes: Death sounds should be less comical and get correctly interrupted on deaths.

notes.title: First Official Playtest - Feedback Changes
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who participated in the first playtest. I've gone ahead and fixed some of the more critical issues that have come up, notably:

 You can now reload with the grip button (instead of emptying your clip)
 Left-Handed mode (Left trigger fires, right trigger is throttle)
 Physics should be more stable (less spin-outs)
 Low-Visibility and Instant Death are now part of the level list. They actually weren't supposed to be part of the first playtest. I had accidentally included them.
 Hitting oncoming traffic will result in a blackout, loss of a Medkit and reset.
 Scrape sparks from colliding with wall, traffic and other bikes.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44943690/bd510044060e2e8d86c44e51f20dccb3a2a36c99.gif
 Speedometer replaced throttle/brake meter to make user inputs clearer. I want a tacometer as well but this will come later.
 Tutorial gate counts shortened in both instances.
 Stutter in tutorial (or the first time you see an enemy) that would often cause a spin-out and framerate hitch. The hitch itself hasn't been fixed yet, however it should no longer have serious gameplay implications (physics).
 Joy-stick mode: I DO NOT LIKE THIS. I've included a joy-stick mode; it can be found under Options. My opinion is that it is more challenging to make feel comfortable than head movement. It can be made smoother but I'll need more feedback on this. This wasn't how I meant for the game to be played, and I don't enjoy the feeling as much as leaning the body/head to steer.


Again, thank you all, including those who've been very candid in their feedback. I'm excited to make more stuff for you!

notes.title: Hotfix - VR Origin Flip
notes.notes:
It was possible that your VR origin would flip on high-speed collisions. You'd then be facing backwards on the bike.

This should no longer happen.

Have fun!
Joey
